articles.title: Zishu Terminal: A Real Linux Environment on Android
articles.description: Zishu Terminal 6.0.0 turns an ordinary Android phone into a working Linux command-line workstation, with no root access and no emulator. It installs real bash, Python, Git, Node.js and a C/C++ compiler, and it adds a signed package manager so you can install more.

articles.title: Zishu Terminal (Beta) New Update
articles.description:
Zishu Terminal v5.6.5-beta.1 — a lightweight, developer-focused Android terminal built entirely from scratch. Real shell, real encryption, real GitHub cloning, real clipboard management. No root. No fake features. No compromises.
Built on classic Android (android.app.Activity, no AndroidX, no Kotlin)

articles.title: Zishu Terminal (Beta) v5.6.5
articles.description:
What's new in v5.6.5-beta.1:

• Added zgit clone — download public GitHub repos as snapshots
• Fixed binary output rendering (cat on encrypted files now shows instantly)
• zrun now detects shebang and uses the correct interpreter
• zrun path resolution fixed (absolute, relative, ~, $HOME)
• Added verbose mode to zrun
